transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is the third outage this month! Our POS systems are down and customers can't checkout. This is unacceptable!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize. Let me immediately escalate this to our NOC and get you a status update. Can you confirm your store locations affected?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All five locations. We're losing sales every minute this is down. What's your plan to fix this recurring problem?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm escalating this to Priority 1 status. I'm also going to assign a dedicated engineer to audit your network and implement redundancy. This pattern is unacceptable to us too.
